احتلموا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَلَمُوا (iḥtalamū) /iħ.ta.la.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# اِحْتَلِمُوا (iḥtalimū) /iħ.ta.li.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
